newsitem.title: ALBANIA: German troops fire to protect Albania evacuees.
newsitem.headline: German troops fire to protect Albania evacuees.

text.p: German troops sent in by helicopter to help evacuate Western residents fleeing unrest in Albania fired on unidentified gunmen who shot at the evacuees and their aircraft on Friday.

Pictures from a Turkish television crew obtained by Reuters television showed German troops first hitting the ground when the gunmen opened fire from a van and then shooting back. A diplomatic source said the evacuation had been successful with five helicopters airlifting 105 people to neighbouring Montenegro.
The television footage showed several of the evacuees cowering on the tarmac at an airfield near the capital. Some were praying. It showed no one injured in the incident.
He said 105 people, mostly Germans and other European Union nationals, were taken to the town of Podgorica, just over Albania's northern border with Montenegro and would be flown on to Frankfurt.

In Washington, a U.S. defence official announced that the United States had suspended its military evacuation of Americans after a Marine helicopter reported being fired on by a missile from the ground. Officials said 480 U.S. nationals had been evacuated before the suspension.
An Italian military helicopter also reported being shot at during an evacuation operation.
